purpose: Freeze the fail-closed prerequisite and filesystem lifecycle around the existing Mem-Gallery control runner and append-only writer without authorizing a real model, endpoint, numerical run, or score.
scientific_question: Can every future matched Mem-Gallery run be forced onto the same released scheduler state, accepted dataset identity, complete offline model surface, exact service identity, 20-scenario order, 1711-QID denominator, fresh root, and retained terminal evidence before any method quality is observed?
estimand_boundary: This synthetic lifecycle estimates no method quality. It proves only control-flow and evidence invariants on injected mock answers.
preflight_order: require a separately signed WMA Wave-1 TERMINAL_ACCEPTED closure receipt with zero project processes, tmux sessions, and model services
require the exact Mem-Gallery TERMINAL_ACCEPTED dataset evidence root with no rejection marker and verify all four inventory hashes
recompute the dataset semantic identity and bind the exact 20 scenarios, 1711 ordered QIDs, and question-index bytes
require all five exact-revision model receipts, hash inventories, symlink-free snapshots, and network-free offline-load proofs
bind the inert injected-mock answer and tokenizer identity to the accepted protected Qwen inventory
require synthetic-only lifecycle authorization with zero network, zero GPU processes, bounded wall time and disk
validate every answer-free query projection against the accepted question-index identity before creating a run root

filesystem_contract.root: An absent non-symlink exact child of an explicitly supplied allowed run scope.
filesystem_contract.start: The previously frozen RawRunWriter creates the root and immutable RUNNING evidence before the first injected answer call.
filesystem_contract.append: Exactly 20 scenario results append in accepted dataset order; their flattened QIDs equal the frozen 1711-QID sequence byte-for-byte.
filesystem_contract.accept: Only the complete denominator can create TERMINAL_RAW_COMPLETE and EVIDENCE_SHA256SUMS.
filesystem_contract.reject: Any post-root exception creates TERMINAL_REJECTED, retains partial evidence, and disables same-root recovery.

model_and_service_contract.real_service_receipt_validation: A future successor must add the exact local endpoint, process, physical/logical GPU map, tokenizer inventory, launch receipt, and health response. This v1 has no real-service execution branch.

covered_invariants: active Wave-1 denial before run-root creation
missing acceptance marker and evidence-hash drift denial before run-root creation
model or service identity drift denial
complete 20-scenario and 1711-QID synthetic lifecycle accepted by the existing reconciliation core

transition_rule.next_allowed_gate: After independently accepting Wave 1 and stopping its services, execute the already frozen Mem-Gallery data materialization and integrity stages. Then accept all exact model inventories and separately freeze a real adapter-family lifecycle successor.
transition_rule.not_unlocked: No data download, model download, live service, real lifecycle, 42-run numerical surface, scoring, comparison, SOTA claim, or cleanup is unlocked by this artifact.

explicitly_prohibited: using a RUNNING, REJECTED, ambiguous, or still-serving WMA state as a release receipt
creating a real Mem-Gallery run root through this synthetic-only controller
calling localhost, the network, a GPU process, or a model from the injected synthetic answer surface
accepting missing, extra, duplicate, reordered, hash-drifted, or answer-leaking queries
falling back to another model, mutable revision, online download, or symlinked snapshot
scoring synthetic answers or admitting them to the baseline table
editing, resuming, overwriting, or deleting a terminal or partial evidence root
